matched_case_studies.case: VerdiCraft Botanicals (Multi-Country Sustainable Cosmetics & Certified B-Corp Group)
matched_case_studies.historical_roi: Candidate survey completion jumped from 17.2% to 54.6%, cross-country rating std dev dropped by 39% (from 0.49 to 0.30), manual HR tracking fell by 87% (from 11.5 to 1.5 hours/month), and organic impressions grew 3.2x (from 58.1k to 186.0k/quarter).
matched_case_studies.outcome_use: Historical sandbox outcome for context. Challenge telemetry is synthetic and this score is a retrieval heuristic.
matched_case_studies.transfer_scope: Transfer the shared mechanisms. Check workforce and site fit before adapting interventions.
